programme.desc: The Alexander Nevsky Cathedral in Sofia, Bulgaria, is a captivating testament to Russian-Bulgarian camaraderie and Orthodox heritage.

programme.title: Kochi, India
programme.desc: Sommer Shiels learns about the local ways of life at the backwaters of Kerala. She also goes cycling along the hills and tea plantations of Munnar.

programme.title: Santorini Greece
programme.desc: With its sea-drowned caldera, black-sand beaches and crimson sunsets, Santorini is the archetypal Greek island fantasy.

programme.title: Mauritius; Experience The Romance
programme.desc: To avoid your love life become captive of mundane, we suggest adding a whimsical element to it. Presenting, five best experiences which you can savor together in Mauritius with your "special" someone.

programme.title: Hyderabad
programme.desc: As Charlie explores Hyderabad’s food scene, he unveils a gastronomic legacy forged by centuries of cultural exchange, royal dynasties, and migration.

programme.title: Mukteshwar
programme.desc: Healer and Rohan camp under the stars at Mukteshwar, a quiet, forested village in the lap of the Himalayas.

programme.title: Banyan Tree, Maldives
programme.desc: Indeya Passfield visits Vabbinfaru island, a hidden tropical gem just 20 minutes away from Male, the bustling capital of Maldives.

programme.title: Ahmedabad & Gir, India
programme.desc: Sommer Shiels learns about the life of Mahatma Gandhi at Sabarmati Ashram. She also goes on a safari in Gir National Park, to see lions.

programme.title: Cappadocia, Turkey
programme.desc: Turkey is a perfect place for some adventure and old charm with rugged landscapes, carved castles and varied mezze. Hot air balloon is an attractive sport done by all visitor.

programme.title: Scotland
programme.desc: Forget the clichés -a these five epic Scottish experiences will shatter everything you thought you knew.

programme.title: Nagthat
programme.desc: Rohan and Healer visit Nagthat, a charming hamlet in the mountains of Uttarakhand.

programme.title: Larnaca
programme.desc: Travel enthusiast, Sabrina sets out to find out more about the city but is waylaid when she finds a flock of flamingos at a lake side.

programme.title: Delhi
programme.desc: Charlie's Indian culinary escapade begins in Delhi, where the city's passion for food hits him from the get-go.

programme.title: Goa, India
programme.desc: Sommer Shiels gets to know Goa through experiences such as shipwreck diving, finding secluded beaches and meeting an artist inspired by the state.

programme.title: Portugal
programme.desc: The stupendous architecture of Portugal’s monuments reveals the various stages of the country’s evolution.

programme.title: Lucknow
programme.desc: Charlie’s journey through Lucknow’s kitchens takes him straight into the city’s royal legacy.

programme.title: Nag Tibba
programme.desc: Situated on the foothills of Uttarakhand’s Garhwal mountains, Nag Tibba is a popular trekking destination.

programme.title: Nicosia
programme.desc: Sabrina Chakici unravels the stories of Nicosia, the cultural heartbeat of Cyprus, through her experiences.

programme.title: Dublin
programme.desc: Pubs in Ireland are more than a place to drink; they’re centers of cultural gatherings and the nucleus of Irish ‘craic’.

programme.title: Badami, India
programme.desc: Through the cave and rock cut temples of Badami, Sommer Shiels finds out the intriguing story of the place.

programme.title: Varanasi
programme.desc: In Varanasi, Charlie discovers the sacred intersection of faith and food, where spirituality shapes the city's distinctive cuisine.

programme.title: Khirokitia
programme.desc: From the Neolithic village of Khirokitia to the beaches of Paphos, Sabrina Chakici explores all that the Troodos ranges in Cyprus have to offer.

programme.title: Galway
programme.desc: From Ballynahinch castle to Kylemore Abbey, Olivia explores some of the postcard-perfect castles of Connemara, one of Ireland’s most romantic regions.

programme.title: Ancient Temple of Egypt
programme.desc: From the stories of famous Egyptian pharaohs to Greco-Roman beliefs, the ancient temples of Egypt contain mysteries waiting to unfold.

programme.title: Kanatal
programme.desc: Rohan attempts to get Healer off his fear of water by taking him on a boat ride on the waters of Asia’s biggest man-made lake.

programme.title: Hampi, India
programme.desc: Sommer Shiels is transported to the golden era of the Vijayanagar empire through the temples of Hampi.

programme.title: Varanasi
programme.desc: In Varanasi, Charlie discovers the sacred intersection of faith and food, where spirituality shapes the city's distinctive cuisine.

Chilli tries to convince Bluey that perfection isn't easy, or absolutely necessary.

programme.title: The Face Painting Badge

programme.title: Army

programme.title: Musical Statues
programme.desc: At the end of a long day, Bluey and her family are out of sync and out of sorts, so Mum gets everyone to play musical statues.

programme.title: Stories
programme.desc: Indy thinks she's no good because her model horse looks like a cow, but Calypso encourages her not to give up, so she tries to fix it with a little help from Winton.

programme.title: Andy and the Blue Whale
programme.desc: Andy blasts off in his safari sub to the Atlantic Ocean in search of a blue whale.

programme.title: Sticks
programme.desc: Bella and Lift play with a stick that makes the perfect magic wand. They visit Patch, who has a tasty recipe - sticky stick critters!

programme.desc: As the Squirrels appreciate Norrie's new bike, they discover that she doesn't know how to ride it, she finds it too difficult.

With separate editions out of Asia, Europe, Africa and the Americas, Global Business features analysts and news-makers supported through a global network of correspondents.

programme.desc: Three contestants face a pressure test set by Michelin-starred chef Michael Wilson. The contestants must recreate Michael's incredible Marguerite Opera dessert, nicknamed The Tower of Terrori.

programme.title: 蘭嶼之歌 / Song Of Orchid Island
programme.desc: 蘭嶼紅蟲為患，島上人只信大頭目及巫醫巴達兩人。年青醫生何維德到蘭嶼找尋曾到此研究紅蟲而失蹤的父親，因而與未婚妻白丹娜鬧翻。後來何與孤女雅蘭相愛，惹來西呼達嫉妒；同時何為島民治病，令巴達信眾日減，西呼達、巴達均伺機殺何，何身陷險境而不自知…….

programme.title: 飛燕金刀 / Vengeance is a Golden Blade
programme.desc: 總鏢頭李志山的妻子私通對頭人龍震天，並設計先偷飛龍刀，再殺害李志山及女兒小燕，幸好最後李氏父女成功逃脫。小燕長大後，更成為武功高強的女劍客，誓要為死去的母親報仇。直至一個偶然的機會，小燕遇到仍然在生的母親，才駭然發現真相，原來自己一直被父親的謊言所蒙騙。.

programme.title: 鏢旗飛揚 / The Protectors
programme.desc: 淩霄及關望龍同為一流鏢師，深得主人器重。關單戀主人孫女方燕，方卻情系于淩。關遷怒淩，竟與黑道中人金不換密谋劫鏢，嫁禍淩...

programme.title: 荒江女俠 / Lady Of Steel
programme.desc: 鐵臂金剛方甯、方靜押送賑銀救濟黃河災民，途中受到盜寇的突襲，全家老少遭殺害，惟稚女方瑛琪為玄真道長救出，抱入深山撫養。瑛琪長成後，盡得玄真道長武功真傳。其時金兵圖大舉進犯中原，玄真道長授瑛琪一劍一信，著其下山投效義軍首領夏子龍...

programme.title: 包剪石沓 / Melody of Love
programme.desc: 幽默風趣的愛情喜劇，三個年青醫生常開道、史瑞科、蕭而可，被安排追求院長的三個女兒靈珍、靈珊、靈玲。三人以「包、剪、搥」來決定追求對象，他們的追女橋段層出不窮，用盡英雄救美、苦肉計、死纏爛打等愛情藥方，卻全部失靈，烏龍百出...

programme.title: 鷹王 / King Eagle
programme.desc: 某天，名震江湖的鷹王遇見重傷的天一堂六舵主，他臨終前告訴鷹王天一堂堂主已被大舵主洪擎天所害，鷹王雖不願多管閑事，但還是遭到洪摯天及其手下顏冰兒的追殺。其後，鷹王出手拯救被監車壓住的女孩，遭到暗算，幸得天一堂七舵主顏玉蓮相救，兩人結為朋友。鷹王告知顏玉蓮六舵主的遺言，並指出其胞妹冰兒不是善類….

programme.title: 醜聞 / Scandal
programme.desc: 在河北省某貪汙成風的小縣內，流浪漢甄明與賈亮因掌握一眾縣官的貪汙和醜聞證據，得以順水推舟假扮縣長，把各官員玩弄於股掌之中，峰迴路轉，結局卻出人意表。全片除帶出人生如戲的黑色幽默，也狠狠地鞭撻為官者殘民以自肥的無恥行為。.

programme.title: 大羅劍俠 / The Secret Of The Dirk
programme.desc: 女俠明珠的師父遭黑虎幫歹徒偷襲重傷，臨終囑往找故友之女青青，探問失蹤財寶。歹徒偷聽得遺言，先去劫走青青，途遇「大羅劍俠」周應龍，怒打不平…….

programme.title: 乾隆皇君臣鬥智 / The Emperor and the Minister
programme.desc: 翰林院大學士劉墉機智多謀，口才了得，常難倒乾隆。乾隆心中不忿，欲設計刁難他，但劉墉人急智生，妙語如珠，反令乾隆又再語塞。.

programme.title: 春火 / My Son
programme.desc: 楊國良是探長兒子，國良怪父沉迷工作，母離世仍在查案，隔膜頓生。國良遇上舞女梅琳，兩人母親皆歿，了解下迅即同居生活。國良因生活費花盡到俱樂部賭錢，被陳彪騙下巨款，更強姦梅琳。國良憤然殺死陳彪，遭警察圍捕......

programme.title: 五毒 / The Five Venoms
programme.desc: 蜈蚣功的鹿峰、蛇功的韋白、蠍子功的孫建、壁虎功的郭追、蛤蟆功的羅莽，各擅勝場，不同型格。電影風格奇特，一開始五毒門清理門戶，派出楊得將五個高手就地正法。同出師門，卻受師父追殺，有人說是喻他一手建立的張家班命运，張徹拍出殺戮的悲劇，沒有他慣常的大義浩然，卻有天地不容的毀滅性。.

programme.title: 茅山殭屍拳 / The Shadow Boxing
programme.desc: 以「趕屍」為業的陳師父與徒弟受託押運九具殭屍，啟程上路。未料途中兩具竟逃脫。其中一具實際上並非殭屍，而是為躲避敵人追殺而假扮的江湖豪客。更令人意外的是，此人與陳師父同樣身懷絕技，二人皆為深不可測的武林高手！.

programme.title: 鐵羅漢 / The Iron Buddha
programme.desc: 追風刀劉鵬為采花大盜小天尊所殺，遺言徒弟盧漢去京師尋護龍刀復仇。途上，盧助康氏姊妹玉笙與玉簫退敵；抵京後又路見不平，救韓五嫂一命，因而結識韓的女兒牡丹...

programme.title: 不了情 / Love without End
programme.desc: 在這部浪漫愛情經典中，夜總會歌女李青青邂逅英俊青年湯鵬南，兩人漸生情愫，卻在感情路上經歷無數誤會、分離和折磨。當他們終於重燃愛火時，青青卻得知一個噩耗，最終無奈迎來悲慘的結局。.

programme.title: 少林搭棚大師 / Return to the 36th Chamber
programme.desc: 本片是少林三部作的第二部，講述劉家輝飾演的周仁傑一心要去少林寺學功夫，最後竟扮成寺中的三德和尚，並創出「搭棚式」的少林武藝。.

programme.title: 夜生活的女人 / Woman of the Night
programme.desc: 本片由三個內容不同的故事構成。青年喜歡偷窺異性，結果其姐懇求雇主交際花實行肉身布施，驚醒青年迷夢。好色總經理常設計欲打美貌秘書的主意，偷香不到，反被懲戒。好丈夫喪失性能力，不願妻子痛苦，故作暴躁舉動，讓其妻帶著女兒離去，十年後，一家才得以諒解。.

programme.title: 拳擊 / Duel Of Fist
programme.desc: 范克在父親臨終時發現自己有一個同父異母的兄弟汶烈在泰國。於是，他去找汶烈，並發現他為了救治重病中的母親，而成為一名拳手。兩人相遇後，更被牽連在地下拳擊賭博當中。.

programme.title: 中國超人 / Super Inframan
programme.desc: 太空科學研究深所獲悉有來自冰河時代的人類所化之怪物將會危及地球上的所有人類。這批怪物兇悍異常，神通廣大，大有霸佔整個世界的野心。為了對付這批怪物，科學研究所所長劉英德以自己數十年來的研究心得把勇敢的科學研究員雷馬製造成萬能超人。中國超人開始了與怪物的戰鬥…….

programme.title: 寒煙翠 / Mist Over Dream Lake
programme.desc: 陳詠薇的父母準備離異，於是把她送到章家暫住。章家長子凌霄、次子凌風、三女凌雲和年輕畫家余亞南都對詠薇很好，使她在章家農場度過了難忘的暑假。.

programme.title: 蝙蝠傳奇 / Legend of the Bat
programme.desc: 楚留香與一點紅自從在神水宮殺大破無花和尚后，又回到中原。結識了李玉函與柳無眉。在此之前，楚曾遇到連串莫名其妙的事情，後來，楚才知柳身患宿疾，她需要以楚的人頭到蝙蝠島去換取一種藥物治病，是以欲置楚於死地，楚親往蝙蝠島了解事件，才驚覺陰謀中又有陰謀…….

programme.title: 阿牛發達記 / Big Times for the Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: 阿牛拾得一袋珠寶，從此富貴。這時，周大叔假意叫他簽約迎娶一名女子，却原來是個陷阱，為的是要賣掉他的房子。最後，可憐的阿牛又回復一貧如洗….

programme.title: 落葉飛刀 / The Deadly Knives
programme.desc: 日本財閥小川，為奪燕姓所有之森林，勾結劣紳關甫淩，屢次對森林主人燕劍光遊說，均被拒絕。小川收買燕家內侄徐千偷取燕老鑰匙，潛入密室，盜取地契。後被燕老發覺，徐千竟將燕老痛毆致死。關甫淩有女月花，與燕家小主人子飛，本有嫁娶之約，燕老死後，但鑑於其父與日人相勾結，國恨家仇，兒女私情無法兼顧，只得示意決絕….

programme.title: 哪吒 / Na Cha the Great
programme.desc: 改編自著名中國神話《封神演義》中的章節，故事講述三千年前哪吒為救父母而犧牲自己的性命，後來因元神被置於蓮花內令他復活，哪吒更獲賜兩件寶物去解救因暴帝而受苦的百姓。.

programme.title: 逃亡 / The Bloody Escape
programme.desc: 顧回自幼於土匪窩中長大，卻不屑土匪頭子杜健強的殘忍狠毒。少女唐麗被杜迫作壓寨夫人，顧將唐救出，終被黑、白兩道追殺。顧終鼓起勇氣參與剿匪行動，贏回一個重新做人的機會。.

programme.title: 人蛇鼠 / Fangs of the Cobra
programme.desc: 莊家農場獨子莊士德海外歸來，接手由胡麟管理的產業。胡一直與德之表妹曼玲勾結，圖取莊家產業，並欲利用曼玲美色迷惑德！怎知在阿芬飼養的小蛇「西西」幫助下，反令德與芬結成夫婦。後來胡買來一條專咬人的野老鼠，欲將德之初生嬰兒咬死，「西西」為救嬰兒，與野鼠作殊死搏鬥...

programme.title: 玉面飛狐 / The Silver Fox
programme.desc: 玉面閻羅夏梧與司馬秋同為鏢局金婁文之義子，後司馬鏢因偷取兩本功夫秘笈而傷夏之臉，並將師父殺死；夏抱初生女兒逃走。夏抱女入山修練，並傳武藝予女兒玉面飛狐，命她出山向司馬劫鏢報仇。後飛狐遭司馬擒住，幸為書生徐繩所救。飛狐回山后，父疑心其與徐有私情，把她關在地窟中...

programme.title: 鳳還巢 / Return of the Phoenix
programme.desc: 兵部侍郎程浦將次女雪娥許配予好友之子穆居易，庶室程夫人既憤且惱，對居易訛稱長女雪雁乃雪娥，催促二人早日成親。居易見雪雁貌醜而癡，嚇得留書出走。富豪朱煥然對雪娥心儀已久，趁此良機冒充居易，依期迎親……本片由李香君、金峰分飾男、女主角，配搭新鮮；而蔣光超與莊元庸一胖一瘦的諧趣演出，更令人笑破肚皮。.

programme.title: 賣命小子 / The Magnificent Ruffians
programme.desc: 武林名門世家子弟袁鷹飛為了對付虎威鏢局少鏢頭關雲，拉攏四位失意江湖高手對付他。豈料四人與關雲不打不相識，反成好友。後袁鷹飛設下毒計害死關雲，四人悲憤交集，遂聯手為友復仇。.

programme.title: 青春1000日 / The Pure and the Evil
programme.desc: 凌玫瑰與方素美是一對感情要好的同窗。凌幼失怙恃，由當舞女之姊撫養成長，方則出身富家，受母呵護備至。畢業後，凌由淪落風塵攀至選美冠軍，方則滿足於平淡生活中；但她們卻偏偏同時愛上劉醫生。最後一件意想不到的事發生，改寫了他們三人的一生….

programme.title: 佛都有火 / The Boxer From The Temple
programme.desc: 故事講述，某寺青年僧人「瘋子」，性格瘋瘋癲癲，行為全不符僧人規範。該寺主持玄明方丈卻認為「瘋子」與佛有緣，並因應其性格與氣質，授以「癲羅漢拳」。「瘋子」有了武功後，動輒出拳傷人，方丈只得將其逐出寺門...

programme.title: 邪 / Hex
programme.desc: 民國初年廣州西關的陳家大屋，家道中落只剩下陳秀英及其入贅之丈夫楊振宇。秀英多病，而振宇又鬱鬱不得志，故常遭振宇辱打。直至自稱陳家僕人之女梁綺華的出現，聯同秀英反抗，竟錯手將振宇殺死！秀英自始活在驚恐之中，最終被振宇的鬼魂嚇死！原來這只是振宇在與綺華合谋殺害秀英，就在振宇以為可與綺華共築愛巢之際，秀英鬼魂出現...

programme.title: 江山美人 / The Kingdom and the Beauty
programme.desc: 正德皇帝江南遇李鳳，兩人互生情愫。臨別前正德聲言回京後會立即迎娶李鳳。一年後，當他派人接李鳳回宮時，她已病重，無法承受長途跋涉。雖然最終及時趕到，卻在心愛之人的懷裡離世…….

programme.title: 廣東靚仔玉 / Kid From Kwangtung
programme.desc: 故事講述反清聯盟義士陳貴被清廷高手駱一虎所殺，陳妻偕女小薇避難到廣龍鎮。鎮上長久武館的吳教頭和冠忠武館的何教頭世代互爭雄長，常起衝突，連子侄輩亦各不相讓。何教頭之侄家玉好勝佻皮，因救小薇而識破了張老師為反清聯盟南方二舵主的真正身份。後陳妻、吳教頭、何教頭、張老師逐一被駱一虎所殺，家玉決往找駱一虎報仇...

programme.title: 大殺四方 / The Rebel Intruders
programme.desc: 故事描述，民初北方軍閥混戰，民不聊生，紛紛向南逃難，三位青年王緒、金正平和魚漢生，夾在難民群中，來到戰區邊沿。王因出手營救一女難民，致遭地方民團首領陳祖光的手下追捕，幸得風塵女子紅菱所救…….

programme.title: 死角 / Dead End
programme.desc: 故事描述，狄龍與姜大衛游車河時，遇富家女李菁的跑車拋錨，狄載她返家，一見鍾情。後李往姜之修車廠取車，再遇狄，狄約李去跳舞，夜總會中，碰見李兄陳鴻烈，陳不喜歡狄，故二人只好提早離去；歸家途中，目擊員警追捕逃犯，逃犯掉下之手槍，被狄檢到，從此改變他的命?..

programme.title: 盜劍 / Rape of the Sword
programme.desc: 韓九重為奪削鐵如泥的青霜劍，誘殺師弟談鶴鳴；談鶴鳴的妻子耿六娘隱姓埋名在將軍府為傭，伺機奪劍報仇。將軍女兒嬌龍拜六娘為師，練成一身武藝，並與六娘師侄羅翼虎相戀。翼虎順嬌龍之意，深夜到親王府盜劍，然而寡不敵眾，失手被擒；嬌龍率眾營救，與韓九重等人展開連場激戰。.

programme.title: 牛鬼蛇神 / Tales of Larceny
programme.desc: 軍閥割據時代，江湖人物及狡黠之徒所玩弄的傳統騙術層出不窮，「蛇神」、「李三腳」、「三隻手」等一群妖言惑眾的騙徒令人云亦云的愚民上釣，反映舊時代一切牛鬼蛇神眾生相。.

programme.title: 五郎八卦棍 / The Eight Diagram Pole Fighter
programme.desc: 楊家將被敵軍突襲，幾近全軍覆沒，僅存兩名兒子生還。楊家五子遂逃入少林寺，向少林僧人學習「狼牙棒法」，後來更創出「五郎八卦棍」。最終，楊五郎與眾寺僧聯手，為楊家將報仇。.

programme.title: 藍與黑 / The Blue and the Black
programme.desc: 抗日戰爭期間，少年孤女唐琪愛上青年張醒亞。家庭的壓力與戰爭的動盪令這對有情人飽受煎熬。直至唐琪不幸被強姦，不容於家庭, 而唯有走上夜總會歌女的不歸路...

programme.title: 十二金錢鏢 / Twelve Deadly Coins
programme.desc: 喬茂押鏢時，遇女贼袁玉蓉，舉刀要殺之際，卻被袁的美麗媚態吸引，後兩人互生愛慕，更發現憑獨門武器「十二金錢鏢」名震天下的俞劍平，與背後操控袁的老頭，有段血海深仇….

programme.title: 西廂記 / West Chamber
programme.desc: 張生、崔鶯鶯才子佳人相會，俏紅娘從中牽赤繩；西廂夜訪，私定終身；崔老夫人知情大怒，憤而拷紅；紅娘怨夫人不該言而無信，終成就百年姻緣。.

programme.title: 十字鎖喉手 / Shaolin Hand Lock
programme.desc: 李成鷹的父親被多年好友凌豪設計所殺。李成鷹從父親身上學會“十字鎖喉手”的秘技，誓要為死去的父親報仇。於是，他潛入凌家作護衛，期間也巧遇失散多年的兄長，兩兄弟聯手大戰殺父仇人。.

programme.title: Song Of Orchid Island
programme.desc: Dr. He moves to the remote Lanyu island off the coast of Taiwan to look for his long lost father, and starts to run a clinic curing islanders who are bitten by the fatal red worms there. He meets Ya Lan who works as a nurse in his clinic and falls in love with him. Things get vicious for Dr. He as a jealous islander plots to get rid of him...

programme.title: Vengeance is a Golden Blade
programme.desc: Convoy Master Li's wife has an affair with his rival Long, who plans to steal Li's Golden Blade and kill him as well as his young daughter. Li and his daughter manage to escape and the latter grows up to be a skilled swordswoman who vows to avenge her mother's death - a lie told by Li. The truth is revealed when she sees her mother alive by chance.

programme.title: The Protectors
programme.desc: Ling Hsiao and Kuan Wang Lung are two guard chiefs working for an old convoy master. Lung is secretly in love with Fang Yen, the master's granddaughter but Yen is attracted to Ling Hsiao instead. In order to win her back, Lung sets up a trap to steal the convoy and frames Ling Hsiao for it.

programme.title: Lady Of Steel
programme.desc: A young swordswoman Fang Ying Qi sets out to join the Flying Dragon Clan in their defense against the invading Jin forces. Fang also intends to avenge the murder of her parents by bandit leader Han 20 years ago. Han has since taken on a false identity as a member of the Flying Dragon Clan and Fang must rely on her deadly sword skills to stop Han.

programme.title: Melody of Love
programme.desc: Three young doctors pursue three hard-to-get beauties in this romantic film set in the 70s "a-go-go" era. They have no idea where to start and use Rock-paper-scissor method to match themselves with the girls. The tactics and tricks they use are hilarious and they have to reshuffle their plans when nothing leads to success!

programme.title: King Eagle
programme.desc: A young swordman, King Eagle, unwillingly gets involved in the internal affairs of a powerful clan and becomes their target. He is saved by the female chief of the clan, Lin, and falls in love with her. However, Lin's sister is part of all evil plots and betrays her. Even so, Lin begs King Eagle not to harm her sister.

programme.title: Scandal
programme.desc: The roguish scamp Zhen and his best friend Chia collects proof of corruption from the officials in this comedy-drama. After a string of blackmailing, they end up in positions of power, but what is to happen next?

programme.title: The Secret Of The Dirk
programme.desc: The inhabitants of the City of Liu are forced to flee when the vicious Black Tigers gang raids their city, but are able to hide all their gold and treasures in a valley. A team of swordswomen led by Liu wants to get their hands on the treasures before the bandits, but both parties will have to contend with the wandering swordsman Chou for them...

programme.title: The Emperor and the Minister
programme.desc: The ingenious imperial scholar Liu Yung always embarrasses Emperor Chien Lung with his quick wit and gift of gab. The emperor purposely sets him up to solve the seemingly unsolvable. However, Liu Yung resolves it easily with wit and style and foils the emperor's plot once again.

programme.title: My Son
programme.desc: Kuo, a police's son, blames his father for his mother's death. He has no job, spends time in night clubs and always gets into fights. One night, Kuo rescues Mei from being raped and they become friends. Kuo wants to support Mei and her family so he goes gambling hoping to gain more money but bad luck seems to be following them with tragic outcomes.

programme.title: The Five Venoms
programme.desc: A dying master dispatches his last pupil to track down five ex-students who are each an expert in his own lethal combat style. He fears they will steal the fortune belonging to their clan and tasks his pupil to prevent their attempt.

programme.title: The Shadow Boxing
programme.desc: Chan and his apprentice Fan transport zombies for a living and are hired to move nine zombies in one go. When two hop away, it is revealed that one is actually a man in disguise trying to escape his enemies. It turns out that both the disguised zombie and Chan are martial arts experts!

programme.title: The Iron Buddha
programme.desc: After a notorious rapist Xiao kills his master and the entire clan, Han the last surviving disciple, decides to take revenge. He must find the legendary Hulong Blade to counter Xiao's Evil Poisonous Sword, but as Han has never seen Xiao before, he is deceived when Xiao poses as an ally to try and steal his Blade in the process.

programme.title: Love without End
programme.desc: In this classic romantic melodrama, nightclub songstress Qing Qing falls for the handsome Peng Nan. However, the two go through an emotional roller coaster of misunderstandings, separations and mutual torment. When the two finally fall back into love, Qing Qing receives a shocking revelation that brings the story to its inevitable sad ending.

programme.title: Return to the 36th Chamber
programme.desc: The second film of the trilogy, Gordon Liu plays Zhou Ren Jie, a man who impersonates a monk in order to learn kung fu in Shaolin, and eventually creates his own Shaolin style of 'scaffolding kung fu".

programme.title: Woman of the Night
programme.desc: The movie offers three stories of love and obsession. In the first tale, a young student with a voyeuristic habit spies on two of his female roommates. The second story follows an office manager who develops an infatuation for his secretary. The last story is a complex family drama about a debilitated father who forces his family to leave him.

programme.title: Duel Of Fist
programme.desc: Fan Ke discovers at his father's deathbed that he has a half-brother, Wenlie, in Thailand. He goes to find Wenlie, who became a boxer to support his sick mother. Following their encounter, the two got involved in the underworld of boxing match gambling.

programme.title: Super Inframan
programme.desc: Transformed from a young laboratory researcher, the thunderbolt-fisted Inframan must battle Princess Dragon Mom who wakes up from hibernation to conquer the earth with her army of mutant monsters.

programme.title: Mist Over Dream Lake
programme.desc: A young girl Chen is sent away by her parents who are going through divorce, to stay with the Chang's. On the Chang's farm, she meets their two sons, the youngest daughter and a young artist, and spends a summer with them that she will never forget.

programme.title: Legend of the Bat
programme.desc: It is rumoured that people can buy anything they desire on the mysterious Island of Bats so long as they have money. The charismatic swordsman Chu Liu Xiang and his friend travel to the island to seek answers but realize they are not the only ones who want to unveil the mystery of this place.

programme.title: Big Times for the Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: Ah Niu finds a bag of jewels on the street and becomes rich. It is at this time that Uncle Zhou asks him to sign a contract to marry a girl, but it turns out to be a trap for Ah Niu to sell his house. In the end, Ah Niu becomes poor again...

programme.title: The Deadly Knives
programme.desc: Martial arts student Yen returns from school to defend his family homestead against Japanese financiers after his father is killed. On the way, he meets Hua and falls in love with her. However, Hua discovers that her father is plotting with the Japanese to take Yen's property and wants to murder him. It is a tough choice between family and love...

programme.title: Na Cha the Great
programme.desc: Adapted from a chapter of the classic Chinese legend "Investiture of the Gods", this is the story of Na Cha set 3000 years ago. After Na Cha sacrificed his life to save his parents, he is reincarnated with his spirit embodied in a lotus flower and is armed with two magic weapons to save the people from their despotic emperor.

programme.title: The Bloody Escape
programme.desc: Ku is a skilled Kung Fu artist brought up by the bandits and does not agree with the brutal leader of the bandit's camp. He rescues Tong, a young lady forced to become the leader's wife, causing both the authorities and bandits to come after them. Ku has to stand up against the bandits that he grew up with so as to start a new life for himself.

programme.title: Fangs of the Cobra
programme.desc: Incredibly, the title serpent is not a harbinger of horror, but actually the film's hero. This virtuous viper sniffs out bombs, fights gangs, battles a baby-killing rodent and even takes on a duplicitous woman. This one-of-a-kind thriller will be applauded by reptile fans everywhere.

programme.title: The Silver Fox
programme.desc: The formidable swordswoman Silver Fox was a child when her father was senselessly wounded by his step brother, and her mother raped. It is payback time eighteen years later, as her father trains her up with kung fu to take revenge on his behalf.

programme.title: Return of the Phoenix
programme.desc: An imperial minister Cheng betroths his pretty younger daughter, Ye, to his friend's son, Mu. His wife however, refuses to let Ye marry before her elder daughter Yan, who is ugly and undesirable. Yan is asked to pretend as Ye to meet Mu but scares him away. A rich guy who likes Ye meanwhile pretends as Mu to attend the wedding...

programme.title: The Magnificent Ruffians
programme.desc: Renowned martial arts clan heir Yuan Ying Fei hires four down-and-out martial artists to eliminate the local escort agency's young chief, Guan Yuan. Unexpectedly, the four befriend Guan instead. When Yuan's conspiracy leads to Guan's death, they unite to avenge him.

programme.title: The Pure and the Evil
programme.desc: Two teen girls, Rose and May, become close friends despite their different social backgrounds. The rich girl May moves to America but returns years later to see Rose, now a beauty queen and bar girl. Rose is immediately attracted to Fang's fiance and their relationship quickly deteriorates when Rose sets out to pursue him...

programme.title: The Boxer From The Temple
programme.desc: A young monk, The Kid, was expelled from the temple due to his crazy ways. After leaving the temple, he fights a cruel bandit's son and befriends a prostitute. As he fights for justice, his "Crazy Lo Han Fist" improves with every fight.

programme.title: Hex
programme.desc: This supernatural mystery tells the story of a sickly wife and her maid conspiring to kill her beastly husband, leading to a string of events with spooky twists and turns.

programme.title: The Kingdom and the Beauty
programme.desc: Emperor Cheng Te meets country maiden Li Feng on a visit to Southern China. It was love at first sight and the Emperor leaves with a promise that Li Feng would be his empress. When he sends for Li one year later, she was too ill to withstand the arduous journey and arrives just in time to die in the arms of her beloved...

programme.title: Kid From Kwangtung
programme.desc: After many years as a respected actor and action choreographer, the Shaw Studio finally gave the dependable and commendable Hsu Hsia a chance to direct his own movies. He didn't waste the opportunity, inviting three other kung-fu designers to help on this fight-filled thriller. Wang Yu, co-star of such classics as Dirty Ho and The Kid With A Tattoo, here takes center stage as a young rascal caught

programme.title: The Rebel Intruders
programme.desc: Thousands of displaced refugees rush to the southern towns to avoid the civil war in north China. Three such young men trained with martial arts skills become sworn brothers, and accidentally got involved in the battle of the rebel leaders in town when they save a refugee girl. Can they fight back against the rebel gangs?

programme.title: Dead End
programme.desc: Uninhibited youth Chun meets a rich girl Wen when her car breaks down and drives her home. Chun falls in love with Wen but Wen's brother dislikes him and forbids his sister to see him. He humiliates Chun and gets Chun beaten up, so Chun takes the pistol he has found accidentally on the street to Wen's home and shoots her brother dead.

programme.title: Rape of the Sword
programme.desc: The film starts out with two students fighting for their deceased master's sword called the "Green Frost Sword". Han kills the other student, takes the sword and offer it to the king. The wife of the other dead student plots to take revenge, going undercover to retrieve the sword at the first opportunity in this tale of revenge and betrayal.

programme.title: Tales of Larceny
programme.desc: Connecting all the antics of bosses, monks, beggars, and thieves is the slippery and sinuous efforts of three pickpockets so adept at their chosen skill that they can even trick three beauties of their underwear without missing a step.

programme.title: The Eight Diagram Pole Fighter
programme.desc: The Yang Generals were ambushed by the enemies and only two of the sons survived. The fifth son of Yang's escapes to Shaolin temple and learns the pole-fighting techniques from the monks, eventually creating his own "Eight Diagram Pole Fight" and teaming up with the Shaolin monks to avenge his family.

programme.title: The Blue and the Black
programme.desc: Set during the Japanese occupation in World War II, a young orphan Tang Qi falls in a love with a young man Chang. However, their love is filled with challenges, from family pressure to the turmoil of war. When Tang Qi was raped, she is expelled from home to become a nightclub singer and embarks on a journey of no return...

programme.title: Twelve Deadly Coins
programme.desc: When Qiao Miao is about to kill the bandit whom he just met, he is attracted by her beauty and they quickly fall in love. The two later discover the blood feud between the owner of the unique weapon - "Twelve Deadly Coins" and the old master who controls the bandit...

programme.title: West Chamber
programme.desc: The story is based on a famous Chinese opera. A young impoverished scholar, Zhang, is enchanted by Hong, the daughter of an influential family whom he meets in a temple. The young couple faces the threat of separation due to her family's objection, so Hong's maid secretly helps to arrange their rendezvous in the West Chamber!

programme.title: Shaolin Hand Lock
programme.desc: Li Cheng Ying's father was set up and killed by his old friend Ling Hao. Li, who has learnt "Shaolin Hand Lock" from his father, is on a mission to avenge his death. He works as an undercover guard at Ling's house where he meets his long-lost brother, and the two team up to take revenge for their father against Ling.

programme.title: Whose Baby is in the Classroom?
programme.desc: Chen, a male teacher in an all girls' high school, is stuck with a baby that isn't his and must take care of it. As he lives on the school grounds, the baby is a source of constant distraction and worry! Luckily, his class warms to the baby and helps him take care of it while he works his charm on Li Ching, an uptight teacher in the same school.

programme.title: The Swordmates
programme.desc: Li asks his swordmate Wang to protect his family while he is away, but Wang rapes his wife and even has his convoy attacked. Li escaped but fears his daughter is still in danger, so he asks the nephew of his master to help protect her...

programme.title: Black Magic 2
programme.desc: Doctor Sing is puzzled by the strange symptoms of his patients and asks his friend for help. The sickness is apparently caused by a black magic that is casted by a wicked man Kong. Kong covets the beauty of Sing's wife and casts an evil love spell on her, while threatening to kill Sing at the same time. Can Sing save his wife and his patients?

programme.title: The Twelve Gold Medallions
programme.desc: This was one of top three films of 1970 and winner of "Outstanding Drama" at the 9th Golden Horse Awards. The evil minister uses twelve golden medallions to summon war hero Yueh Fei back from the frontline and execute him. A group of wandering warriors, led by Yueh Hua and Chin Ping, try to stop the medallion couriers.

programme.title: The Enchanting Ghost
programme.desc: It is love beyond the grave, as a young scholar and his beautiful lover are torn apart forever by his dastardly uncle and his friend, who drive the girl to commit suicide... but with death comes revenge for the enchanting ghost. A spooky yet heart-wrenching tale...

programme.title: The Flying Guillotine
programme.desc: Ma Teng is an assassin of the 'Flying Guillotine Squad', a group of killers commissioned by the Emperor Yung. When Ma starts to question the morality of his missions, he finds himself becoming a fugitive hunted by his former comrades.

programme.title: Hex Vs Witchcraft
programme.desc: A compulsive gambler with bad luck owes money to a violent gangster boss and trades his wife as down payment, causing her to leave him. As he decides to kill himself, a mysterious old man offers him a proposal to marry the ghost of his dead daughter in exchange for cash and an expensive apartment.

programme.title: Have Sword Will Travel
programme.desc: When the head of a manor loses his kung fu skills, he enlists his nephew and fiancee to escort gold to the capital. Along the way, they encounter a mysterious swordsman and join forces with him to stop bandits from stealing the gold.

programme.title: Fast Fingers
programme.desc: After his release from prison, Uncle Bill returns to make a fortune with his past thieving partners. They continue to prey on the unsuspecting public, but are closely watched by the upright police chief, who happens to be the boyfriend of one of Uncle Bill's nieces!

programme.title: Disciples Of Shaolin
programme.desc: Yi is a skilled disciple of the Hong Quan style kung fu who work in a textile mill recommended by his senior, Han. Han warns Yi not to show off his martial arts skill so as to avoid getting into trouble. However, Yi does not listen and eventually gets dangerously involved in the conflict between two opposing textile mills.

programme.title: The Purple Shell
programme.desc: Hui and Ha are stuck in their unhappy marriages and are attracted to each other when they meet at a party. In one of their beach strolls, Ha picks up a purple shell and gives it to Hui as a memento. When Hui's husband finds out about them, he hurts Hui and causes her to become seriously ill, while also blackmails Ha. How will this love story end?

programme.title: Temple Of The Red Lotus
programme.desc: A young guy Wu, heads off to the Dragon Valley to meet his childhood friend Lian Chu, who was promised to be his bride. When he arrives, he finds out that the family of his bride may not be an entirely honest bunch of people. Wu wishes to take Lian Chu with him, so he has no choice but to fight against her family...

programme.title: The Singing Escort
programme.desc: Betty Ting plays Susan, a young woman hiding from her father by being a nightclub singer in Japan. Pop singer Chao Ke-jen (Lin Chong) gets permission from his boss to visit Japan, with the condition that he finds the boss's daughter. Boy finds girl, boy falls in love. But will the father approve?

programme.title: The Anonymous Heroes
programme.desc: In this action comedy, two young men join a rebel group after the Chinese Revolution of 1911 and accidentally become patriotic heroes. Assisted by a warlord's daughter, they successfully help the rebels steal weapons from the warlord.

programme.title: The 5 Billion Dollar Legacy
programme.desc: A crippled billionaire mails a letter to each of his long-lost daughters inviting them to go to Japan, in the hope that he will find a worthy heir to inherit his vast fortune. The sisters finally meet abroad the plane to Japan, and one of them is taken with a man who is going to investigate the death of his lawyer uncle in a mysterious hit-and-run.

programme.title: Mission Impossible
programme.desc: A sword master's daughter is pursued and poisoned by an evil master when bringing back the stolen Golden Sword to the palace. She dies on the run and returns as a spirit to take revenge by killing the evil master, and soon vanishes after returning the sword to the emperor.

programme.title: Facets Of Love
programme.desc: Set in the Ming Dynasty, the story revolves around a brothel and the girls who work there. The film begins by following the life of a girl from a poor family, who is sold by her mother to the brothel. While she is the most beautiful of the girls and attracts many clients, the girl hopes to escape this sad way of life one day.

programme.title: The Happiest Moment
programme.desc: This erotic comedy anthology features three stories about an old man who dies from an overdose of virility pills, a cop who goes on the run after extorting money from a hooker, and a barber's apprentice who encounters a lively corpse in a night vigil. Through playing all these characters, Michael Hui proves himself as a genius of Hong Kong comedy.

programme.title: Boxer Rebellion
programme.desc: The Empress Dowager Cixi believes the Boxers' claim that they have developed a kung fu that makes them impervious to weapons, thus declaring war against the alliances of eight foreign nations. The lack of weapons and good leadership in the Ching government allows the Eight Nation Alliances to take down Beijing.

programme.title: Descendant of the Sun
programme.desc: Shi Sheng is adopted by an old carpenter and grows up to possess extraordinary superpowers. One day, he unexpectedly discovers his identity as the son of the solar deity and learns that his power will be lost during solar eclipse. When an evil spirit appears and wreaks havoc, Shi Sheng must beat him in an ultimate duel to save the world.

programme.title: Two Con Men
programme.desc: Two Con Men is a wonderfully twisted, pseudo-romantic comedy in the vein of "Robin Hood" meets "The Sting". Starring Liang Tien as Clever Chan and Chang Ying (who's done over 400 films) as Tricky Ching, it's the age-old competition between a rookie con artist versus the ultimate, experienced flimflam man. It's a game Chen cannot afford to lose, because people's lives - including his own, hang in t

programme.title: Full Moon Scimitar
programme.desc: Swordsman Ding fought against many swordsmen and won, so he took his first defeat badly and wanted to commit suicide. It is then that he meets the granddaughter of a mystic Sect leader and falls in love. When they want to get married, the Sect leader presents Ding with the "Full Moon Scimitar", on the condition that he will never leave the sect.

programme.title: The Bride Napping
programme.desc: A rich girl Yue Ying, together with her maid Chun Lan, encounter a poor scholar Bian Ji at a fete. Chun Lan realizes Yue Ying is in love with him, but mixes his identity with a bandit due to an old servant's confusion, threatening the couple's union. After a series of complications, misunderstandings and mismatches, Chun Lan finally saves the day.

programme.title: The 36th Chamber of Shaolin
programme.desc: Gordon Liu plays an anti-Manchu rebel who escapes to the Shaolin Temple and learns what it truly takes to become a martial arts master by challenging the 35 Shaolin Kung Fu chambers, eventually creating the 36th chamber himself.

programme.title: Till the End of Time
programme.desc: This is Jenny Hu's stunning debut as a struggling singer who tries to keep her career and marriage intact. This movie also includes seven memorable hit songs.

programme.title: Vengeance is a Golden Blade
programme.desc: Convoy Master Li's wife has an affair with his rival Long, who plans to steal Li's Golden Blade and kill him as well as his young daughter. Li and his daughter manage to escape and the latter grows up to be a skilled swordswoman who vows to avenge her mother's death - a lie told by Li. The truth is revealed when she sees her mother alive by chance.

programme.title: Pale Passion
programme.desc: Fa is an obsessive man who loves his wife Ah Hsia but is easily jealous and abuses her. When she leaves him one day, Fa hooks up with another woman, Hsing. A deadly triangle develops when Fa runs into Ah Hsia again and decides to win her back...

programme.title: One Way Only
programme.desc: Danny is a motorbike workshop owner, once was a renowned motorcycle racer, but were seriously injured in an illegal race. Mai, student of Danny, wins a race in Macau under Danny's help. However, because of money and honour, Mai joins illegal races. After knowing this, Li persuades Mai to stop illegal races, but Mai seems cannot find his way out...

programme.title: Sex, Love and Hate
programme.desc: This masterpiece spins three interconnected tales about Hong Kong society's differing views on love and what women want from love. Follow a trio of Hong Kong women as they explore relationships and fulfil their hopes of finding true love.

programme.title: Marco Polo
programme.desc: Mongolian emperor Kublai Khan is being assassinated while meeting with the Italian explorer Marco Polo. Marco Polo is appointed to lead the troops for the emperor to wipe out the anti-Mongol rebels. Yet, he is touched by these rebels who are resisting the Mongolian invasion of their homeland. Will Marco Polo stay loyal to the emperor?

programme.title: The Grand Substitution
programme.desc: In this Opera epic, a loyal Imperial Court servant gives up his own newborn son to save the prince from an evil official.

programme.title: The Fake Ghost Catchers
programme.desc: Huan Zhu's ghost seeks help from "Fake Ghost Catchers" Bao Tuo and Zhou Peng, after a jealous suitor's ghost seeks vengeance by murdering her and now targeting her sister. Together with actor Wu Shun Chao who possesses a supernatural talent, they unite to protect Huan Zhu's sister from both mortal and spectral threats.

programme.title: The Last Tempest
programme.desc: This sequel to The Empress Dowager continues the tale of Emperor Guangxu and Empress Dowager Cixi. Despite Guangxu's enthronement, his ability to rule effectively is overshadowed by the ever-present power of Cixi. When his attempts to reform the Imperial system are thwarted by the Empress Dowager, Guangxu attempts to curb her power.

programme.title: Heroes Shed No Tears
programme.desc: Kao Chien Fei is a young swordsman who wields a special sword with a teardrop marked on its blade. He is charged with averting an impending crisis in the martial arts world, but the villain, Zhou Tung Lai, wishes to become the ruler in the martial arts world, and launches a scheme to pit the various heroes against one another.

programme.title: Sons Of Good Earth
programme.desc: This is an epic tale set during the time of the Sino-Japanese war. A painter Yu saves a young girl, Lotus, who is being sold to a brothel. They fall in love, get married and settled in to a peaceful life. However, their life is soon shattered by the Japanese invasion and the brutal regime that follows...

programme.title: Five Shaolin Masters
programme.desc: The Qing court plots to kill all Shaolin disciples by burning down Shaolin Temple. This sudden fire killed almost everyone except for five disciples. To take revenge on the Qing court, the five of them train hard in different fighting styles to become "The Five Shaolin Masters".

programme.title: Lovers Blades
programme.desc: The Lovers Blades, a pair of invincible weapons, are to be delivered to the Qing Emperor. However, they accidentally fell into the hands of Xiao Zhong Hui and Yuan Guan Nan, so Imperial Chief Zhuo Tian Xiong hunts them down for the blades. As the battle begins, the secret of the blades are also revealed.

programme.title: Shaolin Martial Arts
programme.desc: The Qing government assigns fighters to destroy Shaolin Temple and kill all the disciples, but two of them successfully escaped. They train under different masters and learn the Wing Chun and Hung Quan styles respectively, finally killing the fighters and taking revenge for the death of their fellow disciples.

programme.title: Tropicana Interlude
programme.desc: Ping and Su are lovers who operate a travel agency specializing in Southeast Asian holidays. Tung, a school mistress, and her students join a guided tour lead by Ping. During the trip, a spoiled kid Li is attracted to Ping but Su thinks Ping has fallen for Tung and leaves. How will Ping deal with the situation and ends up happily back with Su?

programme.title: The Proud Youth
programme.desc: Ling Hu Chong, a Huashan clan's disciple, is assigned to find the successor to the score "The Proud One". Ling identifies Ying for the score but finds out that she is the daughter of the evil clan's leader. At the same time, he is unwittingly dragged into an epic power struggle between clans, with complicated allegiances and perplexing moralities.

programme.title: The Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: This side-splitting comedy sees naive Ah Niu headed to Hong Kong, where he is repeatedly exploited and taken advantage of, and eventually finds himself arrested and imprisoned! Can he survive difficult times and finally overcome adversity?

programme.title: The Water Margin
programme.desc: This is a martial arts epic directed by Chang Cheh. In the Sung Dynasty, the government is run by corrupt officials, so Sung Jiang gathers 108 outlaws at Mount Liang and establishes a band of patriotic heroes to end the repression of brutal overlords.

programme.title: The Butterfly Chalice
programme.desc: In the Ming Dynasty, scholar Tian Yu Chuan defends a fisherman's honour but accidentally kills the governor's son, driving him into exile. Pursued to the river's edge, he is rescued by the fisherman's daughter. Amid danger, love blossoms between them, and Tian seals their bond with his family heirloom, the Butterfly Chalice.

programme.title: Melody of Love
programme.desc: Three young doctors pursue three hard-to-get beauties in this romantic film set in the 70s "a-go-go" era. They have no idea where to start and use Rock-paper-scissor method to match themselves with the girls. The tactics and tricks they use are hilarious and they have to reshuffle their plans when nothing leads to success!

programme.title: The Villains
programme.desc: Hung is an orphan seeking help from her wealthy uncle who has two sons but only dotes on the younger son Feng, a playboy. Feng covets the beauty of Hung and rapes her but when she gets pregnant, Hung is wrongfully accused and gets sent off by her uncle to protect Feng. Will Feng be punished for his villainy?

programme.title: Vengeance
programme.desc: Yu Lou is betrayed by his wife and eventually killed by her lover, Fung, who is the boss of a martial arts school. Yu Lou's brother, Xiao Lou, knows about his tragic death and is determined to take revenge for him.

programme.title: Tiger Killer
programme.desc: Wu Song is appointed as chief constable after killing a tiger with his bare hands when drunk. The wife of his brother Wu Da Lang, seduces Wu Song but gets rejected by him, and engages in an affair with a rich man. They poison Wu Da Lang when he finds out about their affair. To avenge his brother's death, Wu Song kills both of them.

programme.title: A Taste Of Cold Steel
programme.desc: Gan Dai Xiong is killed by Prince Wu, who seeks to seize his Purple Sword. Prince Wu's son join forces with an evil gang to steal the Purple Sword from Gan Dai Xiong's three daughters. Eventually, Gan's daughters team up with their cousin Xu to avenge their father's death.

programme.title: The Yellow Muffler
programme.desc: Japanese director Inoue Umetsugu takes on the glitzy world of nightclub performers in The Yellow Muffler. The film depicts the struggle of two singing sisters, Ching-ping (Irene Chen I-ling) and Pai-hung (Betty Ting Pei) and ends when they are cast in a new movie.

programme.title: Chinatown Kid
programme.desc: After getting into trouble with a local gangster, Chui Ho, in Hong Kong, Tam Dong flees to San Francisco and manages to get a job in a restaurant in Chinatown. Tam Dong finds himself embroiled with the gangsters again in San Francisco, and has to fight Chui Ho when the two meet again...

programme.title: Beyond the Great Wall
programme.desc: Wang Zhao Jun refuses to bribe the imperial painter, so he draws an ugly portrait of her, preventing her from being selected by the Emperor until they meet in person. The painter ends up in exile and plots for Wang to marry the Hun's warlord as a revenge. The Emperor rejects this, provoking a war which is only averted when Wang sacrifices herself.

programme.title: Danger has Two Faces
programme.desc: Many years ago, Inspector Kam killed an innocent man and decided to resign from the police force. He became a professional killer who disguises as a pet store owner. When his best friend, Bobby begins investigating recent murder cases committed by Kam, he discovers that the mastermind behind these cases is actually his superintendent.

programme.title: Apartment for Ladies
programme.desc: A Taiwanese singer comes to Hong Kong in search for her missing younger sister, who had arrived in Hong Kong to be discovered as a nightclub singer. She finds lodging at an apartment for women run by a man-hating landlady, Mrs Chan. However, Mrs Chan cannot confine the young ladies' youthful vitality within the apartment.

programme.title: Ten Tigers of Kwang Tung
programme.desc: The Ten Tigers of Kwang Tung is a group of anti-Ching martial artists who have killed a Ching official. Years later, when five disciples and descendants of Ten Tigers meet one night, one of them is killed by the son of the late Ching official who returns with a vengeance. They must fight against him to protect the Ten Tigers clan...

programme.title: A Friend from Inner Space
programme.desc: A young boy whose parents are separated tries to find happiness in life. One day, he meets and befriends a kind-hearted spirit Ren, who decides to make him truly happy by getting his parents back together.

programme.title: Motel California
programme.desc: Yeon Su decides to remain friends with Gang Hee after seeing how Seok Gyeong can be good friends with Esther.

programme.title: Bad Memory Eraser
programme.desc: Shin is accused of attempting to murder his brother, and Goon learns the truth after checking the dash cam footage.

programme.title: Desperate Mrs. Seonju
programme.desc: So Woo suggests a travel destination to Sang Ah for her trip with Tae Ri. Sang Ah disrupts Seon Ju's family dinner.

programme.title: Love Scout
programme.desc: Ji Yoon resigns as CEO of Peoplez, allowing CareerWay to take over. The employees follow her lead and quit.

programme.title: Salon De Holmes
programme.desc: Hyeon Ji finds out that Min U is bullied at school, and Mi Ri tries to resolve it with Gyeong Ja, Ji Hyeon, and So Hui.

programme.title: Motel California
programme.desc: Yeon Su decides to remain friends with Gang Hee after seeing how Seok Gyeong can be good friends with Esther.

programme.title: Desperate Mrs. Seonju
programme.desc: Sang Ah takes Tae Ri on a trip but finds their time together awkward. Seon Ju asks Nam Jin about his true feelings.

programme.title: Love Scout
programme.desc: Ji Yoon resigns as CEO of Peoplez, allowing CareerWay to take over. The employees follow her lead and quit.

programme.title: Salon De Holmes
programme.desc: Hyeon Ji finds out that Min U is bullied at school, and Mi Ri tries to resolve it with Gyeong Ja, Ji Hyeon, and So Hui.

programme.title: The Brave Yongsujung
programme.desc: Hye Ra grows enraged. Young Ae visits the Masung house, and Ui Joo's condition deteriorates.

programme.title: The Brave Yongsujung
programme.desc: Ui Joo continues his treatment. Han Yang discovers gold bars, and Hye Ra schemes to take down Su Jung.

programme.title: Motel California
programme.desc: Yeon Su decides to remain friends with Gang Hee after seeing how Seok Gyeong can be good friends with Esther.

programme.title: Desperate Mrs. Seonju
programme.desc: Sang Ah takes Tae Ri on a trip but finds their time together awkward. Seon Ju asks Nam Jin about his true feelings.

programme.title: Desperate Mrs. Seonju
programme.desc: So Woo is furious with Sang Ah over Tae Ri's accident. Seon Ju endures a painful time following her divorce.

programme.title: Salon De Holmes
programme.desc: Hyeon Ji finds out that Min U is bullied at school, and Mi Ri tries to resolve it with Gyeong Ja, Ji Hyeon, and So Hui.

programme.title: The Brave Yongsujung
programme.desc: Hye Ra grows enraged. Young Ae visits the Masung house, and Ui Joo's condition deteriorates.

programme.desc: When risk-averse Reuben Feffer's bride dumps him on their honeymoon, his life is thrown completely off track, until, a chance encounter with Polly, an adventure craving, childhood friend.

programme.title: One Flew Over The Cuckoo's Nest
programme.desc: A rebellious convict is sent to a psychiatric hospital for evaluation in 1963 Oregon, and encourages his docile companions to take more control of their lives and defy the tyrannical head nurse.

programme.title: The Mask
programme.desc: Jim Carrey and Cameron Diaz star in this story of a sweet, socially inept bank teller who discovers a mask that transforms him into a superhero ... but one whom you may not want to call for help.

programme.title: Rocky
programme.desc: A small-time Philadelphia boxer gets a supremely rare chance to fight the world heavyweight champion in a bout in which he strives to go the distance for his self-respect.

programme.title: Daredevil
programme.desc: A lawyer blinded by radioactive waste fights crime as an acrobatic martial arts superhero, using his other senses, which have been enhanced.
